items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: I didn't know anything about Clance Williams no more about Reed or something, I heard of some of his music or something.

ctx.x: You say you met Piran in New York? Yeah, two Clance Williams. Oh yeah, well they used to have a kind of a music business together.

Yeah, Clance Williams had a public company. I think he was connected, Piran was connected with us somewhere, I don't know. See when I come to New York I met Clance Williams and he had quite a few other fellows that I've heard of, either known or connected with him in the business, in his music game. Did you ever play with Clance Williams in New Orleans? No I didn't know him until I came to New York. I've heard of him. I think he was in Chicago for a great while. But I didn't know anything about Clance Williams no…
Well I was with the show, I was traveling with the show. Oh I see. That was after you went back to St. Louis you got with the show.
